title: Feature flags: all four toggles have no reader, so turning them on does nothing
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of Setup, filed on the maintainer's word: 「以上都同意，立卡」 (2026-11-05). Measured on `main` `b7075d9908`, with the console in dev mode, unless a line says otherwise. Test app scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

Governing text: ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove. A declared capability the runtime does not honor is an implementation gap.

## What a customer sees

An administrator opens 功能开关, sees 看板泳道, 实时光标, 行内评论 and AI 助手 with a Beta badge, turns one on, saves, and looks for the feature.

## Measured

`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/feature-flags.manifest.ts` declares `ai_enabled`, `kanban_swimlanes`, `realtime_cursors` and `inline_comments`. A repository-wide `git grep` for each key finds the manifest, one settings service test, and docs, and no code that reads the value.

The console's AI panel has its own `aiAssistant` handling in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx`, so that toggle's text promises something decided elsewhere. The toggles were not switched and watched in the UI; this finding is from the code.

## Expected

Remove the four toggles, and the settings page if it is left empty. A flag comes back with the feature that reads it. The maintainer agreed to this direction in the same message.
